title: Initial configuration with an oracle choice tape
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, and let $x$ and $u$ be Boolean words. The initial configuration of the deterministic machine obtained by adding a choice tape, with its ordinary tapes initialized as blank and the added tape initialized to store $u$, is the configuration formed from the initial configuration of $N$ on input $x$ by adding a tape storing $u$ with its head at cell $0$.
hypotheses_covered: a finite nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Bool
